title: MOTHER3
sources: The harness alone, from the game's file (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written

Kana by a rule (Unicode's order from two starts), which every kana met keeps; the signs, letters and kanji by the font's order: in the cartridge (0xCE39FC), in JIS X 0208's order, which the table follows

The order checked by drawing the font at each row's start and end and by reading the cartridge's own texts through the table in sentences, kanji among them; of the eleven signs read in play before, ten agree and one is a space

Played from power-on through the first morning, by the route's own moves replayed with the script: four scenes. What the script said in play agreed with the rows each screen gained on 31 of 31 pictures (the window has two rows and scrolls). No screen without text was among them

The opening has no kanji on screen: the kanji are checked in the cartridge's texts, not yet in play. The font draws small kana barely smaller than full ones; the pictures' rows were written with them where the words have them
notes: Read by the script games/gba/AGB-A3UJ.lua. A talk's whole text is put into a buffer in the board's memory and a word points at the next character to be typed; what the window gains is said each time the typing stops, while a byte says the window is up. A number that is an empty cell in JIS comes out as U+FFFD. Not read: who speaks (the tab takes a name from a list by a number not found), menus, fights, signs drawn over the picture. The script needs a host that gives the cartridge's header to read.
